Level I

Mission Complete: Final Playthrough

Play the full game, trace the engine, and reflect on your code

What You'll Learn

1 Play the complete text adventure from start to finish
2 Identify where your code is called in the engine
3 Trace the flow from user input to game response
4 Reflect on how modular design enables complex systems

Key Terms

Term Definition
Integration How separate modules work together as a whole system
Main Loop The central game cycle (Input → Process → Output)
Modular Design Building systems from independent, replaceable parts
Reflection Thinking critically about what you've learned and built

Reflection Tasks

Complete these tasks after playing the game to victory.

1 Engine Tracing

Open engine/game_loop.py and find:

  1. Where is player.use_item() called?
  2. How does the game parse commands like "go north"?
  3. Where does the game check for victory conditions?
2 OOP Concepts

Reflect on how you used OOP:

  • Encapsulation: How does Inventory protect its _items list?
  • Inheritance: How do Brute and Scout share code with Player?
  • Composition: Why does Player have an Inventory instead of being one?
  • Polymorphism: How does the engine handle damage without knowing your class?
3 Real World

Think about professional software development:

  • Why is it important that the engine handles file I/O, not your Student Code?
  • How would this modular design help if we wanted to add Multiplayer?
